note: Set A is clean and accurate but omits two notable facts on the page: the 40-tube total for the 2 x APSE-20 array and the powdercoated steel flatbar railing post material. Set B captures those facts plus the W2 identifier and the 1x4 cedar T&G siding, so it covers the sheet more completely. However, B repeats the handrail, cable-railing, finished-floor, grade-level and railing-post facts several times and mis-binds '2x4 cedar' as handrail material (2x4 is a size). On balance B's extra correct coverage outweighs its redundancy, though only slightly.
remarks: Both sets render '2 X APSE-20' as array configuration '2 units', which is vague; the page states 2 x APSE-20 (40 tubes). Both also treat 1/8" as cable 'diameter' when the note reads '1/8" STEEL CABLE RAILING' (cable size). The text layer has a typo 'TONNGUE' faithfully quoted by both. Neither set captures the general sheet notes (e.g. spacing may be larger between solar thermal tube arrays, valves/piping not shown), which are arguably important conditions.
